b: Firaxis and the Civilization community are getting together again for CIV GIVE 2026, the seventh annual charity stream in support of Gamers Outreach. The event is set for December 19.

Gamers Outreach is a charity that helps hospitalized families through play, including gaming programs for children in hospitals. TheCivShow has released a teaser trailer for this year’s stream and says the full participant list will be announced soon. Donations are already open through the CIV GIVE 2026 Tiltify page.
We’ll update this post when the lineup and schedule are announced. Firaxis announced the event on X.
